cases.label: Ser Waymar duel with the Other
cases.source: Ser Waymar Royce fights a White Walker in a snow-covered clearing. The Other's magical ice blade clashes with Waymar's steel sword and shatters it.

baselineExpression.environment: snow-covered clearing illuminated by pale blue moonlight reflecting off ice

characters.visual: tall, gaunt figure with pale skin, shifting camouflage armor, and a glowing translucent ice sword
young noble clad in fine armor, holding a raised steel sword

baselineExpression.action: the knight strikes forward with his steel sword against the glowing ice blade of the tall pale creature
baselineExpression.composition: close-up action shot focusing on the clashing swords and the glowing blue light of the ice blade

cases.label: Wight rises and overwhelms ranger
cases.source: Waymar's corpse rises as a wight with icy blue eyes and chokes Will to death in the dark snowy forest.

baselineExpression.environment: dark, freezing forest floor covered in snow and scattered frost

characters.visual: corpse with pale cold skin, torn noble attire, and glowing supernatural blue eyes
terrified ranger crouching in the snow, hands reaching out in defense

baselineExpression.action: the reanimated corpse grips the ranger by the throat, hoisting him up in the dark snow-covered forest
baselineExpression.composition: low-angle medium shot emphasizing the towering threat of the blue-eyed undead knight

cases.label: Rangers at frozen wildling camp
cases.intentSummary: commander and ranger discuss at corpse camp
cases.source: Night's Watch rangers Will, Gared, and Ser Waymar Royce scout deep in the haunted forest and discover a frozen wildling camp with corpses in the snow.

baselineExpression.environment: haunted forest north of the Wall, deep snow, dark pine trees

characters.visual: weathered leather armor, holding a spear, looking uneasy
fine noble cloak over chainmail, standing proudly with a hand on his sword hilt

baselineExpression.action: rangers stand amidst frozen bodies in the snow, pointing toward the dark tree line while debating their next move
baselineExpression.composition: wide shot of snowy forest camp with rangers in the foreground surrounding dead wildlings
